name: vLLM issue #53796: PD-disaggregation cannot use PCIe P2P for KV transfer on Intel Arc Pro B60
notes: vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:latest, Arc Pro B60, PyTorch 2.13.0+xpu, XPU runtime 20260000, Level Zero driver 26.18.38308.1-0, IGC 2.34.4, oneCCL 2022.0.0. Intel engineer zhenwei-intel replies that the ze_ipc support in UCX (openucx/ucx#11218) is still unmerged, so there is no supported PCIe P2P path for KV transfer on B60 today.
